lines.text: Saul put the troops under an oath not to eat before evening, so they left the honey alone.
Jonathan had not heard the oath, so he dipped his staff into the honeycomb and his eyes brightened.
After Israel struck the Philistines from Michmash to Hebron, the troops ate meat with blood, and Saul built an altar.
Saul asked for Thummim if the fault was his or Jonathan's, and the lot fell on Jonathan.
The people rescued Jonathan from death, and Saul gave up his pursuit of the Philistines.
